prose: A Bloomberg report, per its sources: Modal Labs is in funding talks at a valuation around $15 billion - up from $4.65 billion in May - and fellow AI-inference startup Baseten is also in raise talks. The body is paywalled and was not captured, so this summary rests on the headline.

On that basis: the inference-infrastructure tier is re-rating violently as AI workloads shift from training to serving. A 3x markup in four months for Modal signals how scarce investors believe this capacity is. Round sizes and investors are unknown from the capture.
highlights: Modal Labs in talks at ~$15B, per Bloomberg - up from $4.65B in May
Baseten also reported in funding talks
Both sell AI inference infrastructure - the serving layer, not the models
A ~3x markup in four months shows how hot the inference tier is
Paywalled; round sizes and investors unknown
